algorithm: sha256 of the subtree printed by jq -cS (sorted keys, no whitespace, trailing newline)

adaptations: None for the codec: every valid Result and Option vector must decode and encode back unchanged, and every invalid one must be rejected.

The err-problem envelope sets every Problem member, so the diene_problems 0.1.1 codec writes it back unchanged; that codec writes a problem without data as data {} and recoverable false, and no vector covers that.
The combinator and tag lists are checked against the Dart method names and wire tags, which are the same.
